quarterly_data.quarter: NGK Insulators results presentation: FY2025 Financial Results (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: to reliably capture the rapid surge in demand driven by the adoption of AI semiconductors, NGK will swiftly implement large-scale capital investments and continue to expand production capacity.
